# Daily Report — 2026-10-13

## Task Completed
Add `list_sla_exceptions` tool — lists `cmn_schedule_span` records where `type=on` (blackout /
exception windows that pause SLA timers). Scoping options: `sla_id` resolves the SLA's linked
`cmn_schedule` and filters spans to that schedule; `schedule_id` filters directly to a given
schedule (sys_id or name); no scope parameter returns all `type=on` spans. Optional `name_query`
(LIKE) and `repeat_type` filters. Day-of-week labels included in response. Supports pagination.
Registered in `service_desk`, `system_administrator`, and `full` packages.
